comment: Countries are instructed to define minimum data models for every DPI-H component before implementation. This may be too demanding for countries adopting existing international or regional specifications with limited modelling capacity.

anchor.note: p.95 l.Lines 265-272 read as the printed page; section 4.3.1 agrees

public.text: Countries are instructed to define minimum data models for every DPI-H component before implementation. This may be too demanding for countries adopting existing international or regional specifications with limited modelling capacity.
public.suggestedRevision: Allow countries to adopt suitable existing models and define only necessary national constraints, extensions, translations, and mappings, provided national governance and conformance are maintained.
